{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
print("Removing rows with biomarker_baseline == -999...")
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
print("Deduplicating on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq...")
df_clean = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final shape
print(f"Final number of unique patients: {len(df_clean)}")

# Check the arm distribution
print("\nDistribution of arms after deduplication:")
df_clean['arm'].value_counts()"}
